01_portfolio:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: one row per borrower before aggregation.
-- If duplicate borrower snapshots appear, keep the latest snapshot deterministically.
WITH ranked_features AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,snapshot_date,exposure,utilization,debt_service_ratio,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC,exposure DESC,accounts_count DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
borrower_grain AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,exposure,utilization,debt_service_ratio
  FROM ranked_features
  WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       ROUND(SUM(exposure),2) AS exposure_egp,
       ROUND(AVG(utilization),4) AS mean_utilization,
       ROUND(AVG(debt_service_ratio),4) AS mean_debt_service_ratio
FROM borrower_grain;
02_delinquency_trend:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: one account-month row; historical cutoff applied before aggregation.
WITH ranked_snapshots AS (
  SELECT account_id, month_end, balance, dpd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id,month_end ORDER BY account_id) AS rn
  FROM monthly_snapshots
  WHERE month_end<='2025-12-31'
),
account_month AS (
  SELECT account_id,month_end,balance,dpd FROM ranked_snapshots WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT month_end,COUNT(*) AS accounts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN dpd>=30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_accounts,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN dpd>=30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),5) AS late_rate,
       ROUND(SUM(balance),2) AS exposure_egp
FROM account_month
GROUP BY month_end
ORDER BY month_end;
03_utilization_segments:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: reduce feature and outcome sources independently to borrower grain.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,snapshot_date,exposure,utilization,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC,exposure DESC,utilization DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
outcome_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY bad_6m DESC,borrower_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_outcomes
),
borrower_base AS (
  SELECT f.borrower_id,f.exposure,f.utilization,o.bad_6m
  FROM feature_ranked f
  JOIN outcome_ranked o
    ON o.borrower_id=f.borrower_id
   AND o.rn=1
  WHERE f.rn=1
),
segments AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,exposure,bad_6m,
         CASE WHEN utilization<0.3 THEN '01 Under 30%'
              WHEN utilization<0.6 THEN '02 30-60%'
              WHEN utilization<0.9 THEN '03 60-90%'
              ELSE '04 90% or more' END AS segment
  FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT segment,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
       ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate,
       ROUND(SUM(exposure),2) AS exposure_egp
FROM segments
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment;
04_roll_rates:
-- SOURCE-GRAIN CONTROL: deduplicate account-month snapshots before calculating transitions.
WITH snapshot_ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id,month_end,dpd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY account_id,month_end
           ORDER BY account_id,month_end,dpd DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM monthly_snapshots
  WHERE month_end<='2025-12-31'
),
account_month AS (
  SELECT account_id,month_end,dpd
  FROM snapshot_ranked
  WHERE rn=1
),
bands AS (
  SELECT account_id,month_end,
         CASE WHEN dpd=0 THEN 'Current'
              WHEN dpd<30 THEN '01-29'
              WHEN dpd<60 THEN '30-59'
              ELSE '60+' END AS band
  FROM account_month
),
transitions AS (
  SELECT account_id,month_end,band,
         LAG(band) OVER (
           PARTITION BY account_id
           ORDER BY month_end
         ) AS previous_band
  FROM bands
),
counts AS (
  SELECT previous_band,band,COUNT(*) AS transitions
  FROM transitions
  WHERE previous_band IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY previous_band,band
)
SELECT previous_band,band,transitions,
       ROUND(
         1.0*transitions
         / NULLIF(SUM(transitions) OVER(PARTITION BY previous_band),0),
         5
       ) AS transition_rate
FROM counts
ORDER BY previous_band,band;
05_test_deciles:
-- EVALUATION GRAIN: one held-out prediction per borrower before NTILE ranking.
WITH prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY split,borrower_id
           ORDER BY borrower_id,pd DESC,bad_6m DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM predictions
  WHERE split='test'
),
test_base AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m
  FROM prediction_ranked
  WHERE rn=1
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m,
         NTILE(10) OVER(
           ORDER BY pd DESC,borrower_id
         ) AS risk_decile
  FROM test_base
)
SELECT risk_decile,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
       ROUND(AVG(pd),5) AS predicted_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate
FROM ranked
GROUP BY risk_decile
ORDER BY risk_decile;
06_test_calibration:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: one held-out prediction per borrower before probability binning.
WITH ranked_predictions AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY split,borrower_id
           ORDER BY pd DESC,bad_6m DESC,borrower_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM predictions
  WHERE split='test'
),
test_base AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m
  FROM ranked_predictions
  WHERE rn=1
),
binned AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m,MIN(9,CAST(pd*10 AS INTEGER)) AS probability_bin
  FROM test_base
)
SELECT probability_bin,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       ROUND(AVG(pd),5) AS predicted_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate
FROM binned
GROUP BY probability_bin
ORDER BY probability_bin;
07_product_mix:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: deduplicate account dimension and selected month-end snapshot before joining.
WITH account_ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id,product,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY account_id) AS rn
  FROM accounts
),
snapshot_ranked AS (
  SELECT account_id,balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id,month_end ORDER BY account_id) AS rn
  FROM monthly_snapshots
  WHERE month_end='2025-12-31'
),
account_dim AS (
  SELECT account_id,product FROM account_ranked WHERE rn=1
),
month_end_balance AS (
  SELECT account_id,balance FROM snapshot_ranked WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT a.product,COUNT(*) AS accounts,ROUND(SUM(m.balance),2) AS exposure_egp
FROM account_dim a
JOIN month_end_balance m ON m.account_id=a.account_id
GROUP BY a.product
ORDER BY a.product;
08_history_segments:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: reduce feature and outcome inputs to borrower grain independently.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,snapshot_date,history_months,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC,history_months DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
outcome_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY bad_6m DESC,borrower_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_outcomes
),
borrower_base AS (
  SELECT f.borrower_id,f.history_months,o.bad_6m
  FROM feature_ranked f
  JOIN outcome_ranked o
    ON o.borrower_id=f.borrower_id
   AND o.rn=1
  WHERE f.rn=1
),
segmented AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,bad_6m,
         CASE WHEN history_months<36 THEN '01 12-35 months'
              WHEN history_months<84 THEN '02 36-83 months'
              ELSE '03 84+ months' END AS segment
  FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT segment,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,SUM(bad_6m) AS events,
       ROUND(AVG(bad_6m),5) AS observed_rate
FROM segmented
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment;
09_analytical_mart:
-- MART CONTRACT: exactly one final row per synthetic borrower.
-- Every join input is reduced to its intended grain first to block fan-out.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    borrower_id,
    snapshot_date,
    history_months,
    accounts_count,
    exposure,
    utilization,
    debt_service_ratio,
    max_dpd_12m,
    late_share_12m,
    payment_ratio_12m,
    inquiries_6m,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY borrower_id
      ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC,exposure DESC,accounts_count DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,split,pd,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY
             CASE split WHEN 'test' THEN 3 WHEN 'validation' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC,
             pd DESC,
             bad_6m DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM predictions
),
product_rollup AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product)>1 THEN 'Mixed products'
              WHEN MIN(product)='card' THEN 'Card only'
              ELSE 'Personal only' END AS product_group
  FROM accounts
  GROUP BY borrower_id
),
mart AS (
  SELECT
    f.borrower_id,
    f.snapshot_date,
    f.history_months,
    f.accounts_count,
    f.exposure,
    f.utilization,
    f.debt_service_ratio,
    f.max_dpd_12m,
    f.late_share_12m,
    f.payment_ratio_12m,
    f.inquiries_6m,
    p.split,
    p.pd,
    p.bad_6m,
    pr.product_group
  FROM feature_ranked f
  JOIN prediction_ranked p
    ON p.borrower_id=f.borrower_id
   AND p.rn=1
  JOIN product_rollup pr
    ON pr.borrower_id=f.borrower_id
  WHERE f.rn=1
)
SELECT
  borrower_id,
  snapshot_date,
  history_months,
  accounts_count,
  exposure,
  utilization,
  debt_service_ratio,
  max_dpd_12m,
  late_share_12m,
  payment_ratio_12m,
  inquiries_6m,
  split,
  pd,
  bad_6m,
  product_group
FROM mart
ORDER BY borrower_id;

10_threshold_sweep:
-- HELD-OUT THRESHOLD SWEEP: deduplicate borrower predictions before crossing to thresholds.
WITH RECURSIVE thresholds(t) AS (
  SELECT 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t+5 FROM thresholds WHERE t<100
),
prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY split,borrower_id
           ORDER BY borrower_id,pd DESC,bad_6m DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM predictions
  WHERE split='test'
),
test_base AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,pd,bad_6m
  FROM prediction_ranked
  WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT t/100.0 AS threshold,
       COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1) AS true_positive,
       SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=0) AS false_positive,
       SUM(pd<t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1) AS false_negative,
       SUM(pd<t/100.0 AND bad_6m=0) AS true_negative,
       1.0*SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1)
         / NULLIF(SUM(pd>=t/100.0),0) AS precision,
       1.0*SUM(pd>=t/100.0 AND bad_6m=1)
         / NULLIF(SUM(bad_6m),0) AS recall
FROM thresholds
CROSS JOIN test_base
GROUP BY t
ORDER BY t;
11_probability_distribution:
-- DISTRIBUTION CONTROL: one prediction per split/borrower before binning.
WITH RECURSIVE bins(b) AS (
  SELECT 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b+1 FROM bins WHERE b<9
),
splits(s) AS (
  SELECT 'train'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'validation'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'test'
),
prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,split,pd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY split,borrower_id
           ORDER BY borrower_id,pd DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM predictions
),
prediction_base AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,split,pd
  FROM prediction_ranked
  WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT s AS split,b AS bin,
       b/10.0 AS lower_bound,
       (b+1)/10.0 AS upper_bound,
       COUNT(p.borrower_id) AS borrowers
FROM splits
CROSS JOIN bins
LEFT JOIN prediction_base p
  ON p.split=s
 AND MIN(9,CAST(p.pd*10 AS INTEGER))=b
GROUP BY s,b
ORDER BY s,b;
12_exposure_by_risk:
-- FAN-OUT CONTROL: deduplicate prediction and feature sources before borrower-level join.
WITH prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,split,pd,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY split,borrower_id
           ORDER BY pd DESC,bad_6m DESC,borrower_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM predictions
),
feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,snapshot_date,exposure,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC,exposure DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
borrower_base AS (
  SELECT p.borrower_id,p.split,p.pd,p.bad_6m,f.exposure
  FROM prediction_ranked p
  JOIN feature_ranked f
    ON f.borrower_id=p.borrower_id
   AND f.rn=1
  WHERE p.rn=1
),
banded AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,split,pd,bad_6m,exposure,
         CASE WHEN pd<.1 THEN '00-10%'
              WHEN pd<.2 THEN '10-20%'
              WHEN pd<.3 THEN '20-30%'
              WHEN pd<.5 THEN '30-50%'
              ELSE '50-100%' END AS probability_band
  FROM borrower_base
)
SELECT split,probability_band,COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       ROUND(SUM(exposure),2) AS exposure_egp,
       AVG(pd) AS mean_probability,
       AVG(bad_6m) AS observed_event_rate
FROM banded
GROUP BY split,probability_band
ORDER BY split,probability_band;
13_monthly_quality:
-- SOURCE-GRAIN QUALITY CONTROL.
-- Intentionally do not deduplicate first: account_rows versus unique_accounts exposes duplicate/fan-out risk.
SELECT month_end,
       COUNT(*) AS account_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS unique_accounts,
       SUM(balance IS NULL OR payment_due IS NULL OR payment_paid IS NULL OR dpd IS NULL) AS null_rows,
       SUM(payment_paid>payment_due OR payment_paid<0 OR balance<0) AS invalid_amount_rows,
       SUM(dpd<0 OR dpd>180) AS invalid_dpd_rows
FROM monthly_snapshots
GROUP BY month_end
ORDER BY month_end;
14_training_woe_counts:
-- GRAIN CONTRACT: training-only borrower counts with deterministic duplicate guards.
WITH feature_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,snapshot_date,utilization,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY borrower_id
           ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC,utilization DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM borrower_features
),
prediction_ranked AS (
  SELECT borrower_id,bad_6m,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY split,borrower_id
           ORDER BY bad_6m DESC,borrower_id
         ) AS rn
  FROM predictions
  WHERE split='train'
),
train_base AS (
  SELECT f.borrower_id,f.utilization,p.bad_6m
  FROM feature_ranked f
  JOIN prediction_ranked p
    ON p.borrower_id=f.borrower_id
   AND p.rn=1
  WHERE f.rn=1
)
SELECT MIN(4,CAST(utilization*5 AS INTEGER)) AS utilization_bin,
       COUNT(*) AS borrowers,
       SUM(bad_6m=0) AS non_events,
       SUM(bad_6m=1) AS events
FROM train_base
GROUP BY utilization_bin
ORDER BY utilization_bin;
